answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network anchors every active node at a transactional wharf of verifiable identity through cryptographic stake burning. An agent commits an immutable cipher proving unique registration, burning stake according to a superlinear cost function C(k) = S * k^2 where k is the agent's rank. Coordinated swarm attacks face quadratic financial friction, driving total adversary expenditure to an unsustainable zenith.
